matrix_desc_aaguid_model: Authenticator model identifier; identical values identify the same authenticator model.
matrix_desc_aaguid_required: Authenticator model identifier; required in authenticatorGetInfo and exactly 16 bytes when present.
matrix_desc_algorithms: Credential-generation algorithms, ordered from most preferred to least preferred when reported; if present, the list must be non-empty and contain no duplicate entries.
matrix_desc_always_uv: alwaysUv reports Always Require User Verification support and whether it is currently enabled.
matrix_desc_attestation_formats: Supported attestation statement formats; support for none is implied and the string 'none' must be omitted.
matrix_desc_bio_enroll: bioEnroll reports authenticatorBioEnrollment support and whether at least one enrollment exists.
matrix_desc_bio_enroll_preview: FIDO_2_1_PRE prototype bio-enrollment command support and current enrollment state.
matrix_desc_bio_modality: Bio sensor modality reported by the optional sensor query.
matrix_desc_ccn_cpstic: Spanish CCN CPSTIC catalog listing hint, reported as integer level 1 when listed.
matrix_desc_client_pin_absent: No ClientPIN capability was reported; ClientPIN is not built-in user verification.
matrix_desc_client_pin_not_set: The authenticator accepts a client-provided PIN, but no PIN is set yet.
matrix_desc_client_pin_set: The authenticator accepts a client-provided PIN and a PIN is currently set.
matrix_desc_common_criteria: Common Criteria Evaluation Assurance Level hint, reported as integer level 1 through 7 without intermediate plus levels.
matrix_desc_config_commands: Supported authenticatorConfig subcommand identifiers; an empty reported list is allowed.
matrix_desc_cred_blob: Small RP-provided opaque data stored directly with a credential.
matrix_desc_cred_mgmt_preview: FIDO_2_1_PRE prototype credential management command support.
matrix_desc_cred_mgmt_ro: perCredMgmtRO=true means PIN/UV tokens can request the read-only credential-management permission.
matrix_desc_cred_protect: Lets an RP request a credential protection policy during credential creation.
matrix_desc_device_id: Workbench selector or transport identity for the selected authenticator.
matrix_desc_encrypted_credential_store_s: Encrypted 128-bit credential-store state returned only when a persistent PIN/UV auth token is available.
matrix_desc_encrypted_device_identifier: Encrypted 128-bit device identifier returned only when a persistent PIN/UV auth token is available.
matrix_desc_ep: ep reports enterprise attestation capability and whether it is currently enabled.
matrix_desc_fido_certification: FIDO Authenticator certification level hint, reported as integer level 1 through 6; plus levels are encoded as even numbers.
matrix_desc_fips1402_overall: FIPS 140-2 CMVP overall certification level hint, reported as integer level 1 through 4.
matrix_desc_fips1402_physical: FIPS 140-2 CMVP physical certification level hint, reported as integer level 1 through 4.
matrix_desc_fips1403_overall: FIPS 140-3 / ISO 19790 overall certification level hint, reported as integer level 1 through 4.
matrix_desc_fips1403_physical: FIPS 140-3 / ISO 19790 physical certification level hint, reported as integer level 1 through 4.
matrix_desc_firmware_version: Firmware version for the authenticator model identified by AAGUID; authenticators must increase it on firmware changes.
matrix_desc_force_pin_invalid: PIN token subcommands return errors until the PIN is changed successfully when this field is true.
matrix_desc_force_pin_not_required: PIN token subcommands are not blocked by a required PIN change.
matrix_desc_force_pin_required: PIN token subcommands return errors until the PIN is changed successfully.
matrix_desc_hmac_secret: Lets a platform derive credential-scoped symmetric secrets during assertion.
matrix_desc_hmac_secret_mc: Applies hmac-secret behavior during credential creation; requires hmac-secret support.
matrix_desc_large_blob_capacity: Maximum serialized large-blob array size; required when authenticatorLargeBlobs is supported and otherwise must be absent.
matrix_desc_large_blob_extension_item: Authenticator-managed per-credential large blob extension for makeCredential/getAssertion.
matrix_desc_large_blob_key: Per-credential key support for entries in the serialized large-blob array.
matrix_desc_large_blob_key_extension_ite: Returns a per-credential key used by platforms with the serialized large-blob array.
matrix_desc_large_blob_key_missing_comma: largeBlobKey feature detection requires both the extension ID and options.largeBlobs=true.
matrix_desc_large_blobs_command: options.largeBlobs=true means the authenticatorLargeBlobs command is supported and the largeBlob extension path must not be used.
matrix_desc_long_touch_for_reset: Reports support and state for requiring a reset touch of at least five seconds.
matrix_desc_make_cred_uv_required: Requires some form of user verification for non-discoverable credential creation.
matrix_desc_make_cred_uv_skipped: Allows non-discoverable credential creation without user verification when the platform requests it.
matrix_desc_max_credblob_length: Maximum credBlob payload size; must be present iff credBlob is supported and at least 32 bytes when present.
matrix_desc_max_credential_id_length: Maximum Credential ID length supported by the authenticator; must be greater than zero when present.
matrix_desc_max_credential_list_count: Maximum number of credential IDs accepted in one request list; must be greater than zero when present.
matrix_desc_max_msg_size: Maximum CTAP message size the authenticator supports; absent defaults to 1024 bytes.
matrix_desc_max_pin: Maximum ClientPIN length in Unicode code points; encoded PIN input must still fit within 63 bytes.
matrix_desc_max_pin_absent_without_clien: maxPINLength must be absent when ClientPIN is not supported.
matrix_desc_max_pin_default: Maximum ClientPIN length defaults to 63 Unicode code points when ClientPIN is supported and this field is absent.
matrix_desc_max_pin_minimum: When specified, maxPINLength must be at least 8 Unicode code points.
matrix_desc_max_rpids_for_set_min_pin_le: Maximum extra RP IDs accepted by setMinPINLength for minPinLength and PIN complexity visibility; must be present iff setMinPINLength is supported.
matrix_desc_min_pin_length: Current minimum ClientPIN length in Unicode code points; required when ClientPIN is supported and otherwise must be absent.
matrix_desc_min_pin_length_extension: Reports the current minimum ClientPIN length to authorized RPs during credential creation.
matrix_desc_no_mc_ga_permissions_false: PIN-derived tokens may be used for makeCredential/getAssertion permissions.
matrix_desc_no_mc_ga_permissions_true: PIN-derived tokens lack makeCredential/getAssertion permissions; platforms should not fall back to ClientPIN for those permissions.
matrix_desc_pin_complexity_extension: Reports whether an authorized RP is subject to the current PIN complexity policy.
matrix_desc_pin_complexity_policy: Reports support and state for an additional current PIN complexity policy beyond minPINLength.
matrix_desc_pin_complexity_policy_url: URL the platform may show for more information about the enforced PIN policy.
matrix_desc_pin_uv_auth_token: Supports permission-scoped PIN/UV auth tokens; PIN-derived tokens require clientPin=true, UV-derived tokens require uv=true.
matrix_desc_pin_uv_protocols: Supported PIN/UV auth protocol versions in decreasing authenticator preference; if present, the list must be non-empty and unique.
matrix_desc_platform_attachment: plat=true means the authenticator is attached to this client platform; absent defaults to false.
matrix_desc_preferred_platform_uv_attemp: Preferred number of built-in UV token attempts before falling back to PIN or showing an error; must be greater than zero when present.
matrix_desc_remaining_discoverable_crede: Estimated remaining discoverable credential capacity using maximally sized future credentials.
matrix_desc_reset_transports: AuthenticatorTransport values over which authenticatorReset is supported; if present, the list must be non-empty and unique.
matrix_desc_rk: rk=true means the authenticator can create discoverable credentials and answer without an allowList.
matrix_desc_set_min_pin_length: Supports the setMinPINLength subcommand; this option may only appear with ClientPIN or authenticator PIN entry via built-in UV.
matrix_desc_third_party_payment: Marks credentials that may be used for third-party payment authentication.
matrix_desc_transport_fallback: AuthenticatorTransport values reported by getInfo, falling back to discovery metadata.
matrix_desc_transport_getinfo: AuthenticatorTransport values reported by getInfo; if present, the list must be non-empty and unique.
matrix_desc_up_false: up=false means the authenticator cannot test user presence; absent defaults to true.
matrix_desc_up_true: up=true or absent means the authenticator can test user presence.
matrix_desc_uv_absent: No built-in user verification capability was reported. A device that only supports ClientPIN must not report uv.
matrix_desc_uv_acfg: uvAcfg=true means UV-derived tokens can request the authenticatorConfig permission; the option may only appear with authnrCfg.
matrix_desc_uv_bio_enroll: uvBioEnroll=true means UV-derived tokens can request the bio-enrollment permission; the option may only appear with bioEnroll.
matrix_desc_uv_configured: Built-in user verification is supported and presently configured.
matrix_desc_uv_count_since_last_pin_entr: Internal UV attempts since the last successful PIN entry, including failed attempts.
matrix_desc_uv_modality: Built-in UV modality hint used by platforms for user prompts; ClientPIN must not be included.
matrix_desc_uv_not_configured: Built-in user verification is supported but not presently configured.
matrix_desc_vendor_config_commands: Supported vendorPrototype authenticatorConfig command identifiers; an empty reported list is allowed.
matrix_desc_versions: Protocol version strings from getInfo; CTAP 2.3 defines FIDO_2_3 and explicitly does not define FIDO_2_2.
matrix_name_rp_ids_for_minimum_pin_lengt: RP IDs for minimum PIN length
matrix_name_uv_count_since_last_pin_entr: UV count since last PIN entry

overview_ctap_warning_aaguid_required_de: authenticatorGetInfo.aaguid is required and must be exactly 16 bytes.
overview_ctap_warning_algorithms_list_du: algorithms must not contain duplicate values.
overview_ctap_warning_algorithms_list_em: algorithms must not be empty when present.
overview_ctap_warning_always_uv_command_: authenticatorConfigCommands must contain toggleAlwaysUv (0x02) when alwaysUv is reported.
overview_ctap_warning_always_uv_conflict: If alwaysUv=true, makeCredUvNotRqd must be false or absent.
overview_ctap_warning_attestation_format: attestationFormats must not contain duplicate values.
attestationFormats must not be empty when present.
Support for none attestation is implied and must not be listed in attestationFormats.
overview_ctap_warning_config_commands_wi: authenticatorConfigCommands must be absent unless authnrCfg is supported.
overview_ctap_warning_credblob_limit_inv: maxCredBlobLength must be an unsigned integer of at least 32 bytes.
overview_ctap_warning_credblob_limit_wit: maxCredBlobLength must be present if, and only if, credBlob is listed.
overview_ctap_warning_credblob_requires_: Authenticators supporting credBlob must also support credProtect.
maxCredBlobLength must be present when credBlob is listed.
overview_ctap_warning_ctap23_cred_protec: FIDO_2_3 authenticators with some form of user verification must support credProtect unless every credential is implicitly level 3.
overview_ctap_warning_ctap23_hmac_secret: Authenticators that include FIDO_2_3 in versions must support the hmac-secret extension.
overview_ctap_warning_ctap23_pin_protoco: For FIDO_2_3, a non-empty pinUvAuthProtocols list must include protocol 2.
overview_ctap_warning_ctap23_pin_uv_auth: For FIDO_2_3, clientPin=true or uv=true requires pinUvAuthToken=true.
overview_ctap_warning_ctap23_rk_cred_mgm: For FIDO_2_3, rk=true requires credMgmt=true or equivalent authenticator-side inventory UI.
overview_ctap_warning_ctap23_rk_uv_state: For FIDO_2_3, rk=true requires clientPin or uv to be reported as true or false.
overview_ctap_warning_enterprise_attesta: For FIDO_2_3, ep present requires authenticatorConfigCommands to include enableEnterpriseAttestation (0x01).
overview_ctap_warning_fido22_forbidden_d: CTAP 2.3 says FIDO_2_2 was not defined and must not appear in versions.
overview_ctap_warning_largeblob_extensio: The legacy largeBlob extension and largeBlobKey extension must not be reported together.
overview_ctap_warning_largeblob_key_inco: largeBlobKey support is detected only when largeBlobKey is listed and options.largeBlobs is true.
overview_ctap_warning_largeblob_mode_con: options.largeBlobs=true must not be used when the largeBlob extension is supported.
overview_ctap_warning_largeblobs_limit_i: maxSerializedLargeBlobArray must be an unsigned integer of at least 1024 bytes.
overview_ctap_warning_largeblobs_limit_w: maxSerializedLargeBlobArray must be absent when options.largeBlobs is not true.
overview_ctap_warning_largeblobs_require: maxSerializedLargeBlobArray must be present when the authenticatorLargeBlobs command is supported.
overview_ctap_warning_long_touch_command: If long touch for reset is configurable, authenticatorConfigCommands must include enableLongTouchForReset (0x04).
overview_ctap_warning_max_credential_cou: maxCredentialCountInList must be an unsigned integer greater than zero when present.
maxCredentialCountInList must be greater than zero
overview_ctap_warning_max_credential_id_: maxCredentialIdLength must be an unsigned integer greater than zero when present.
maxCredentialIdLength must be greater than zero
overview_ctap_warning_max_msg_size_minim: maxMsgSize must be an unsigned integer of at least {minimum} when present.
overview_ctap_warning_max_pin_length_inv: maxPINLength must be an unsigned integer of at least 8 code points if present.
overview_ctap_warning_max_pin_without_cl: maxPINLength is applicable for ClientPIN only and must be absent when clientPin is not supported.
overview_ctap_warning_max_rpids_invalid_: maxRPIDsForSetMinPINLength must be an unsigned integer if present.
overview_ctap_warning_max_rpids_missing_: maxRPIDsForSetMinPINLength must be present when setMinPINLength is supported.
overview_ctap_warning_max_rpids_without_: maxRPIDsForSetMinPINLength must only be present when setMinPINLength is supported.
overview_ctap_warning_min_pin_extension_: The minPinLength extension requires support for the setMinPINLength feature.
overview_ctap_warning_min_pin_length_inv: minPINLength must be an unsigned integer of at least 4 code points.
overview_ctap_warning_min_pin_missing_de: minPINLength must be present when authenticatorClientPIN is supported.
overview_ctap_warning_min_pin_without_cl: minPINLength is applicable for ClientPIN only and must be absent when clientPin is absent.
overview_ctap_warning_no_mc_ga_without_c: noMcGaPermissionsWithClientPin must only be present if clientPin is also present.
overview_ctap_warning_pin_complexity_ext: If pinComplexityPolicy is listed as an extension, setMinPINLength must be supported.
overview_ctap_warning_pin_complexity_wit: The PIN complexity policy feature requires ClientPIN support.
overview_ctap_warning_pin_uv_auth_protoc: pinUvAuthProtocols must not contain duplicate values.
pinUvAuthProtocols must not be empty when present.
overview_ctap_warning_preferred_platform: preferredPlatformUvAttempts must be an unsigned integer of at least {minimum} when present.
overview_ctap_warning_set_min_pin_comman: authenticatorConfigCommands must contain 0x03 when setMinPINLength is supported.
overview_ctap_warning_set_min_pin_withou: options.setMinPINLength requires the minPinLength extension to be listed.
setMinPINLength may only be present with ClientPIN or authenticator PIN entry via built-in UV.
overview_ctap_warning_transports_for_res: transportsForReset must not contain duplicate values.
transportsForReset must not be empty when present.

overview_ctap_warning_transports_list_em: transports must not be empty when present.
overview_ctap_warning_uv_acfg_without_au: uvAcfg must only be present if authnrCfg is also present.
overview_ctap_warning_uv_bio_enroll_with: uvBioEnroll must only be present if bioEnroll is also present.
overview_ctap_warning_vendor_prototype_c: vendorPrototypeConfigCommands requires authenticatorConfigCommands to include vendorPrototype (0xFF).
overview_ctap_warning_versions_required_: authenticatorGetInfo.versions is a required non-empty array.

overview_hero_description: Raw option values returned by the authenticator. Derived checks and relationships are listed in the matrix below.
overview_not_loaded_message: Inspect the authenticator to populate its capability matrix.
overview_signal_always_uv_tooltip: CTAP option alwaysUv. When true, the authenticator requires user verification for operations that would otherwise allow it to be optional.
overview_signal_authnr_cfg_tooltip: CTAP option authnrCfg. Reports support for authenticatorConfig commands used by policy and maintenance flows.
overview_signal_client_pin_tooltip: CTAP option clientPin. true means Client PIN is supported and set; false means PIN support exists but no PIN is currently set.
overview_signal_cred_mgmt_tooltip: CTAP option credMgmt. Enables listing, updating, and deleting resident credentials through the app.
overview_signal_large_blobs_tooltip: CTAP option largeBlobs. Reports the authenticatorLargeBlobs command path; extension-based largeBlob details remain in the matrix.
overview_signal_pin_uv_auth_token_toolti: CTAP option pinUvAuthToken. Supports permission-scoped tokens after PIN or built-in UV for protected CTAP operations.
overview_signal_rk_tooltip: CTAP option rk. The authenticator can create resident/discoverable credentials found without an allowList. This does not imply credential management support.
overview_signal_set_min_pin_length_toolt: CTAP option setMinPINLength. Reports support for setting a minimum Client PIN length policy.
overview_signal_up_tooltip: CTAP option up. If absent, CTAP treats user presence as supported by default; false means the authenticator cannot test touch or presence.
overview_signal_uv_tooltip: CTAP option uv. Built-in user verification, such as a biometric sensor, reported separately from Client PIN.
